terms_meta_title: Terms of Service | Dress Doctor Douala
terms_meta_description: The rules for using Dress Doctor: booking, prices, payment, and what we do if something goes wrong. Written in plain, simple words.
terms_hero_lead: The rules for using Dress Doctor: booking, prices, what we cover, what we do not, and what happens if something goes wrong.
terms_tldr_pickup: Pickup and delivery are always free, anywhere in Douala.
terms_tldr_cancel: Cancel or change a pickup before our rider leaves, and you pay nothing.
terms_tldr_damage: If we damage your item, we will repair or replace it, or offer fair compensation.
terms_tldr_plans: You can stop a monthly plan at any time. No contract and no fee.
terms_agree_p1: These Terms of Service are an agreement between you and Dress Doctor Limited. When you book a pickup, choose a monthly plan or use our website, you agree to these terms.
terms_agree_p2: We have written these terms in plain language. If anything is unclear, we will explain it fairly.
terms_agree_promiseBody: If we do not do what these terms say, we will make it right. We will clean again, replace the item or pay you back. There is no hidden small print.
terms_services_intro: Dress Doctor cleans clothes and things for your home. Pickup and delivery are free anywhere in Douala.
terms_services_kgText: everyday clothes washed, dried and folded or ironed. You pay for the weight.
terms_services_pieceText: special clothes washed one by one, such as suits, dresses, boubous and kabas. You pay for each item.
terms_services_careTerm: Dry cleaning, ironing, bedding and shoes
terms_services_careText: for clothes and items that need extra care.
terms_services_plansText: Basic, Standard and Premium plans with a set amount of clothes or kilos each month, regular pickups and one simple bill.
terms_services_turnaround: Your clothes are usually ready within 24 to 72 hours. Ask us about our 24-hour express service if you need them sooner.
terms_services_pricesNote: You can see the price of each service on our pricing page. The prices there are part of these terms.
terms_booking_howBody: You can book on our website, on WhatsApp or by phone. We confirm your pickup time by WhatsApp or email within 5 minutes. If you do not use WhatsApp, one of our team members can be your contact person and receive these messages for you.
terms_booking_timesBody: We pick up three times a day: morning (8am to 11am), afternoon (12pm to 4pm) and evening (5pm to 7pm). We work from Monday to Saturday and we are closed on Sunday. Our rider comes in the time you choose, and usually calls you 10 minutes before.
terms_booking_cancelBeforeText: free. Message us and we cancel it. You pay nothing.
terms_booking_cancelOnWayText: if you cancel your order after the rider has left, you pay a fixed 1 000 XAF fee to cover the rider’s petrol and trip costs.
terms_booking_cancelNobodyTerm: The rider arrives and nobody is home
terms_booking_cancelNobodyText: we wait 10 minutes and call you. If we still cannot reach you, we will cancel your order. You will need to book again, and we may prioritise your new booking for the next day.
terms_price_intro: All prices are in Central African francs (XAF) and include tax where tax applies. We tell you the price before you pay. There are no hidden costs and no extra fuel fees.
terms_price_orderTerm: Orders per kg and per piece
terms_price_orderText: you pay when we deliver, after we have weighed or counted your clothes and you have agreed the price.
terms_price_planText: paid in advance, on the same date each month. If you pay every 3 months, you get 10% off.
terms_price_overHeading: If you use more than your plan
terms_price_overBody: If you go over the amount in your plan, we charge the extra at our normal price, per piece or per kilo, whichever is cheaper for you. We always check with you on WhatsApp before we charge.
terms_price_lateBody: If a plan bill is still unpaid after 7 days, we pause your account. You cannot book a new pickup until you pay. We do not charge late fees, and we will message you on WhatsApp before pausing your account.
terms_care_title: How we care for your clothes
terms_care_p1: We sort every load by colour and fabric before washing. We treat stains first and keep delicate clothes apart. Clothes marked “hand wash only” are washed by hand. We dry each item as its care label says.
terms_care_p2: For traditional clothes such as boubous, kabas and agbadas, and for formal clothes, we advise our wash per piece service. Each item then gets its own care.
terms_care_wedding: Wedding dresses, bridal items and party dresses
terms_care_silk: Silk, satin and heavily embroidered clothes
terms_loss_title: If something is lost or damaged
terms_loss_intro: We care for thousands of items every month, and almost all of them come back looking better than before. If something does go wrong, this is what we do.
terms_loss_recleanText: if you are not happy with how an item came back, bring it back within 48 hours of delivery and we will clean it again for free.
terms_loss_damageText: if we shrink, change the colour of or tear an item, we will repair or replace it, or offer fair compensation. A receipt helps us decide faster, but you do not need one for items worth less than 20 000 XAF.
terms_loss_lostText: we cover them in the same way. We tag every item at pickup, so this is rare. If it happens, we look into it and give you an answer within 14 days.
terms_loss_existing: Damage that was already there. We take a photo of it at pickup and tell you.
terms_loss_fault: Damage from a fault in the clothes, worn-out fabric, or things hidden inside, such as a tissue in a pocket that leaves marks.
terms_loss_dryClean: “Dry clean only” clothes that you put in our wash per kg service. If you are not sure, choose wash per piece and we will do it properly.
terms_loss_uncollected: Items that are not collected within 30 days after we first try to deliver them.
terms_loss_reportBody: Tell us about any damage or problem within 48 hours of delivery, and keep the item as you received it so we can check it. After 48 hours, we cannot be sure whether the problem happened while we had it.
terms_refuse_intro: For health, safety or technical reasons, we do not take a few kinds of items. If we find one when we sort your clothes, we send it back without cleaning it.
terms_refuse_fluids: Items heavily soaked with blood, paint, engine oil or harmful chemicals.
terms_you_intro: To get your clothes back the way you want them:
terms_you_pocketsText: coins, tissues, pens and earphones can stain or damage clothes.
terms_you_delicateText: if something is hand wash only, dry clean only, or very special to you, tell us at pickup.
terms_you_stainsText: tell us where a stain is and what caused it. This helps us treat it well.
terms_you_checkText: count them and look at them before you accept them.
terms_you_contactTerm: Keep your phone number up to date
terms_you_contactText: so our riders can reach you.
terms_plans_amountHeading: How the amount in your plan works
terms_plans_amountBody: Each plan gives you a set amount every month, in pieces or in kilos, depending on what you choose. The amount starts again on your billing date. Anything you do not use is **not** carried over to the next month.
terms_plans_cancel: You can stop at any time. There is no contract, no fee and no notice period.
terms_plans_midMonth: If you stop part-way through a month, you can still use the rest of that month. We simply do not bill you again.
terms_plans_pause: You can pause your plan for up to 3 months each year, for example if you travel or move. We start again where you stopped.
terms_plans_changeBody: You can move to a bigger or smaller plan at any time. A bigger plan starts straight away, and you only pay for the rest of the month. A smaller plan starts on your next billing date.
terms_outside_body: We work around the rain, the traffic and sometimes the power cuts in Douala. If something big, such as heavy floods, unrest or a long power cut, stops us delivering on time, we tell you as soon as we can, pay back any charges that are affected, and start again as soon as it is safe. If we are not able to serve you for more than 24 hours, your plan billing pauses by itself.
terms_law_p1: These terms follow the laws of the Republic of Cameroon. If we cannot settle a problem together, it goes to the courts of Douala.
terms_law_p2: Please talk to us first. Almost every problem is solved in one WhatsApp chat. We take complaints seriously, and we would rather fix a problem than argue about who is right.
terms_changes_p1: We may change these terms when our service changes. If we make an important change, we change the “Effective” date and tell our plan customers by WhatsApp or email at least 14 days before it starts, so you have time to read it.
terms_changes_p2: If you keep using our service after the change starts, it means you accept the new terms. If you do not accept them, you can stop your plan before they start, with no fee.
